fusions.name: Scratched Dirt
fusions.desc: You scratch a spray of grit 3 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage to everything in the cone, with a 30% chance to leave each one [Blunted], its critical hit chance lowered, for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Ledge Pounce
fusions.desc: You pounce on a target up to 6 tiles away and land with stone-hard claws, dealing 28 damage that is always a critical hit and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Righting Twist
fusions.desc: You twist back onto your feet, removing up to 3 conditions from you, and your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Upright Landing
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a stone shield worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 45 seconds. You gain +5% dodge chance.
